result.reason: The changes are targeted and preserve unrelated intent, but the operative language does not fully reach the preferred position. Section 13.3 applies its breach-based revocation exception to any licence, potentially qualifying the expressly irrevocable paid-up licence in Section 13.2. It also prohibits only revocation and suspension, not termination, so the Services/subscription licence is not expressly terminable only for an uncured material breach. The affiliate, contractor, and successor-transfer coverage is otherwise substantially aligned.
